title: Comprehensive Format Matrix & Technical Specifications
subtitle: Discover the full range of supported input and output formats across images, audio, video, and documents, all processed 100% client-side.

images.title: Images & Vector Graphics
images.description: High-performance image transformation powered by multi-threaded Web Workers and OffscreenCanvas with zero GPU memory leaks.

specs.name: Color Bit Depths
specs.details: 8-bit, 24-bit RGB, and 32-bit RGBA with full alpha transparency preservation

specs.name: Multi-Resolution ICO
specs.details: Packs 16x16, 32x32, 48x48, 64x64, 128x128, and 256x256 icons into a single binary file

specs.name: Lossless & Lossy Modes
specs.details: Configurable WebP, AVIF, and JPEG quality compression (1% to 100%) and lossless PNG

specs.name: Vector Sanitization
specs.details: Automated SVG DOMParser sanitization stripping scripts, external URLs, and event listeners

audio.title: Audio & Sound
audio.description: Studio-grade audio decoding and PCM WAV synthesis running entirely via the native browser AudioContext pipeline.

specs.name: Quantization Bit Depths
specs.details: 16-bit signed integer, 24-bit signed integer, and 32-bit IEEE 754 floating-point PCM audio encoding

specs.name: Sample Rate Resampling
specs.details: OfflineAudioContext resampling to 48,000 Hz, 44,100 Hz, 22,050 Hz, or 16,000 Hz

specs.name: Channel Mapping
specs.details: Full stereo preservation or automated downmixing to clean single-channel mono

specs.name: Format Verification
specs.details: RIFF header validation and metadata duration extraction without external decoders

video.title: Video & Animation
video.description: Client-side video demuxing for soundtrack extraction and high-resolution keyframe snapshots using native HTML5 media elements.

specs.name: Soundtrack Extraction
specs.details: Directly demuxes audio tracks to uncompressed 16/24-bit PCM WAV at original sample rate

specs.name: Keyframe Capture
specs.details: Captures pristine full-resolution video frames at 0s, midpoint, or user-selected timestamps

specs.name: Hardware Decoding
specs.details: Leverages device GPU video decoding pipelines for fast frame seeking and zero server transfer

specs.name: Dimension Preservation
specs.details: Maintains native video width, height, and display aspect ratios during snapshot capture

documents.title: Documents & Structured Data
documents.description: Instant document conversion, structured data serialization, and multi-page PDF generation running in pure TypeScript.

specs.name: Markdown & HTML
specs.details: Bi-directional conversion with sanitized semantic HTML output conforming to CommonMark standards

specs.name: Structured Data
specs.details: Bi-directional JSON to CSV/TSV table serialization with automated delimiter detection and escaping

specs.name: Client-Side PDF Generation
specs.details: Compiles plain text and markdown into clean multi-page PDF documents with custom margins

specs.name: Binary Encoders
specs.details: Encodes and decodes UTF-8 text and raw files to RFC 4648 Base64 strings and Hex dumps
